reassessment_note: Weekly desk 2026-08-29: Fed pivot from dovish to hawkish (57% September rate hike probability vs 34% prior) materially increases downside risk on 3x leverage into rate hike cycle. While small/mid-cap cloud/AI/fintech thesis is validated by IWM record highs, CRWD/DDOG guidance beats, and small-cap 34.5% valuation discount, reducing TQQQ leverage from 16.15% to 10% to de-risk. UPST down 33% YTD underperforms SOFI's earnings beat; trimming UPST from 8.55% to 3% and redeploying to SOFI from 3.8% to 8%. Increasing IWM from 12.35% to 15% to capture small-cap breadth. Raising cash from 9.75% to 15% for dry powder ahead of rate decision. Core cloud/AI theme (CRWD, DDOG, MDB, SNOW) maintained.
research_notes: Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole speech (2026-08-28) delivered hawkish inflation warning: PCE at 3.7% is concerning, no forward guidance, sparking market repricing of September rate hike from 34% to 57% probability. This reverses prior dovish bias and materially increases leverage risk. However, small-cap cloud/AI/fintech thesis remains validated: Russell 2000 hitting record highs (+23% YTD, beating Nasdaq 100's +19%), trading at 34.5% earnings discount. Cloud leaders confirm strength (DDOG +88% YTD with 36% YoY growth, CRWD raised FY27 guidance to $6B). Fintech split: SOFI beat earnings (+40% revenue, +35% members), rallied 6%; UPST down 33% YTD. Bitcoin rebounded to $78.7k after Aug 18 stop loss. Japan (EWJ) +31.7% trailing 12m. Regional banks (KRE) momentum fading with rate hike expectations rising. Biotech (XBI) at 5-year highs with strong FDA activity window. Market reflecting shift from "rate cuts coming" to "rate hikes likely," requiring leverage reduction into October FOMC decision while maintaining long growth thesis.
